title: Six-term lawmaker says balancing Europe and Russia a 'dilemma' for Seoul
caption:
Lawmaker Song Young-gil suggests the Ukraine war is approaching a forced compromise due to a lack of direct NATO and US troop involvement. He argues Seoul must now navigate the delicate balance of maintaining ties with both Europe and Russia.

Source: Koreaherald - Six-term lawmaker says balancing Europe and Russia a 'dilemma' for Seoul
